map.销连接能传扭矩吗？: Can a pin connection transmit torque?
map.可传递较小扭矩（靠剪切），大扭矩需键/花键；销多用于定位与过载保护（剪断销）。: It can transmit small torque (by shear); large torque needs keys/splines; pins are mostly for locating and overload protection (shear pin).
map.为什么定位用过渡配合？: Why use transition fit for locating?
map.定位销需不需松动又能拆装，常用过渡配合（如 H7/m6），过盈太紧难拆、间隙太松: Locating pins need to be removable yet not loose, so transition fit (e.g., H7/m6) is common; interference is too tight to remove, clearance too loose for precision.
